Climate change threatens habitats of chinkaras and bees, studies suggest

Two separate studies indicate that climate change poses a significant threat to wildlife habitats in India. One study suggests that chinkaras, a type of gazelle, may lose their habitat due to changing climate conditions. Another study raises concerns that the majority of solitary bee species could face starvation as a consequence of climate change.
